approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Rock's Lava API guidance identifies Apple TV and Roku channels as examples of custom APIs that can be built with Lava, but warns that Lava webhooks do not include security by default.

notes: Read-only source inspection verified the Lava webhook handler matches active defined values by URL/method, reads Template and EnabledLavaCommands, and renders Lava without an explicit permission check in the inspected handler path.

The Apple TV/Roku API example portion remains official-source-backed; this verification confirms the local handler security caveat and reinforces that agents must inspect configured webhooks before using Lava APIs operationally.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: Triumph's GitHub Spotlight for the v17.0.29 pre-alpha notes that the Roku TV app feature was added for Rock v16.7, making Roku coverage version-sensitive.
Rock Roku pages display custom Lava-driven content as part of the application and render SceneGraph-oriented output rather than normal Rock CMS HTML.
Rock Roku documentation describes Roku support as a way to extend Rock-powered digital ministry to Roku TV through Rock-managed Roku integration.
Roku commands are executed by setting a rockCommand and command-specific parameters on supported controls, and multiple commands can be chained by separating command names with commas.

notes: Read-only source inspection verified rockCommand usage with command-specific parameters such as video URL, media element GUID, title, artwork, related entity, watch map, and resume behavior.
The local templates verify the command pattern, but the comma-chaining behavior remains source-documentation-backed rather than independently exercised in a running Roku client.

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: A Rock Roku application includes configuration such as page-view tracking, page-view retention duration, and API key settings, so Roku troubleshooting should start with the application record before page Lava.

notes: Read-only SQL verified Roku Application Detail, Roku Page Detail, TV Application List, and TV Page List admin blocks, plus the connected instance's TV Site row and page-view columns.

Cached upstream Rock source verifies Roku application settings include enable page views, page-view retention duration, API key, login/authentication page, and Roku components, so troubleshooting should begin with the application record before page Lava.
